limitations: No exact KOFIA PDF/CSV monthly individual chart-to-slide reconciliation
KOFIA approx807만 Jan2026 is not 2026-10 active subscriber count
Video stated 806만 and 54조 could be rounded or snapshot timing; not exact 807만 54.7조 in all cases
A trust ISA does not legally mean deposits only

2026 March anniversary promotions are expired or conditional; no guaranteed cash award in October.
